invoicing.policy: Invoicing 2.21.0 preserves Parts 1–25 and adds Part 26 Cross-Module Integrations / Accounting Boundary without a tenant schema change: Invoicing remains authoritative for invoice lifecycle data, Accounting stays an optional dependency, cross-module journal writes and reversals are isolated behind PostgreSQL savepoints, a failed optional Accounting write cannot roll back the invoice mutation, retryable failure evidence retains the idempotent accounting event key, and existing company-scoped accounting links continue to prevent duplicate postings.
